infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_benefic: When you apply treatment to an ally, the stars align — they gain ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ seconds of regeneration: their wounds and bleeding slowly ebb away.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_essentialdignity: When the target is below ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% health, your healing applied to them is ‖color:gui.green‖1.5‖end‖ times more effective.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_lightspeed: When someone aboard the submarine is unconscious, you gain ‖color:gui.green‖40‖end‖% movement speed.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_aspectedhelios: Crew within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units of you continuously recover from their ‖color:gui.orange‖injuries‖end‖ (‖color:gui.green‖1.5‖end‖ per second) while their health is below ‖color:gui.green‖40‖end‖%.\nIt does nothing above that threshold — it only pulls you back from the brink.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_stargate:
When the mission begins, every crew member gains a charge of Celestial Stasis.
When a crew member's ‖color:gui.orange‖health drops below 1%‖end‖, the charge is automatically consumed:
they gain 15 seconds of ‖color:gui.orange‖Unyielding‖end‖ — they cannot fall unconscious and deal ‖color:gui.green‖25‖end‖% more damage.
Each crew member can trigger this once per mission.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_benefic: The Benefic's light rests on you: your wounds and bleeding are slowly ebbing away.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_helios: Your injuries are being soothed by starlight (‖color:gui.green‖1.5‖end‖ per second).
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_stargate: When you are close to death, this charge is consumed to grant you 15 seconds of Unyielding.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_stargate_grace: You cannot fall unconscious and you deal ‖color:gui.green‖25‖end‖% more damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_balance: The chosen crew member deals ‖color:gui.green‖40‖end‖% more ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_spear: The chosen crew member gains ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖melee attack speed‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖ranged attack speed‖end‖.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arrow: The chosen crew member gains ‖color:gui.green‖35‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖movement speed‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖swimming speed‖end‖.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_bole: The chosen crew member gains ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖stun resistance‖end‖ and steadily recover from ‖color:gui.orange‖injuries, bloodloss and bleeding‖end‖.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_spire: The chosen crew member gains ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖repair speed‖end‖ (mechanical and electrical) and ‖color:gui.orange‖hull welding‖end‖ speed.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_ewer: The chosen crew member has ‖color:gui.orange‖no need for oxygen‖end‖ for the duration.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_astrodyne: Every Arcanum card you play is counted: once all three of a round are played, Astrodyne answers you —\ngaining ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% walking speed, ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% swimming speed and ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% ranged attack speed for 20 seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_six:
You begin to draw: you receive an ‖color:gui.orange‖Astral Draw‖end‖.
Hold it and press use to draw that pole's three cards; sixty seconds later it becomes the other pole's deck, and the cycle continues.
To play one, take the card out of the deck and drag it onto a crew member's limb in the health interface — only that one character receives its effect, and the card is spent.
If you lose it, you can fabricate a replacement from ‖color:gui.green‖1 plastic‖end‖.
WARNING: these cards answer only to an astrologian — anyone else who takes them is burned.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_redraw: When you deconstruct an item, there is a ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% chance the output is doubled.\n(Genetic materials and circuit components excluded.)
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_draw: When you loot a large creature, there is a ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% chance to find ‖color:gui.orange‖unresearched genetic material‖end‖.\nShops on research stations and cities will also begin selling genetic materials.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_balance_boost: Astrodyne: you deal a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% more damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spear: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% melee attack speed and ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% ranged attack speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spear_boost: Astrodyne: a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% melee and ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖% ranged attack speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_arrow: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖35‖end‖% movement speed and ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% swimming speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_arrow_boost: Astrodyne: a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% movement and ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% swimming speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_bole: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖stun resistance‖end‖ and steadily recover from ‖color:gui.orange‖injuries, bloodloss and bleeding‖end‖.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spire: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% repair speed (mechanical and electrical) and hull welding speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spire_boost: Astrodyne: a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% repair and hull welding speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ewer: You have ‖color:gui.orange‖no need for oxygen‖end‖ for the duration.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ewer_boost: Astrodyne: you consume a further ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% less oxygen.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_astrolabe: Gain an Astrolabe — a small hand-held ranged weapon.\nIt fires a ‖color:gui.orange‖beam of starlight‖end‖ that hits instantly and applies ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖.\nRequires no ammunition. It occupies both hands, so you must take it out of your inventory to use it.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_astrolabe: An astrologer's star-reading instrument, small enough to fit in a pocket.\nRaise it and starlight bends into a beam. Its power never runs out — no ammunition of any kind is needed.\nAstrologians are versed in Combust, so whatever it strikes keeps burning.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_earthlystar: Gain an Earthly Star, and unlock its fabrication recipe. Place it on the ground and it spends ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ seconds gathering starlight. After that, the moment the room it sits in starts ‖color:gui.orange‖flooding‖end‖, it blooms: a single burst that repairs the hull within ‖color:gui.green‖250‖end‖ units, then it fades away. Each Earthly Star works only once — you must fabricate a new one.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_earthlystar: A star not yet lit. Leave it on the ground and starlight slowly gathers. Once charged, it needs only to be submerged: it blooms, mends the hull around it, and fades. It cannot foresee harm — it can only be placed in advance. The timing is everything.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_combust: You deal ‖color:gui.green‖25‖end‖% more ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖ damage, and ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% more damage to ‖color:gui.orange‖ballast flora‖end‖.\nYou take ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% less ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖ damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: Crouch and hold for ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖ seconds, and the Wheel unfolds beneath you: you and crew within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units take ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% less damage. Crew keep it for about 5 more seconds after you stand up — you must crouch again to renew it.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_sect_bastion: The umbral phase settles over you: maximum health +‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖%, movement speed +‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_sect_shield: The stars cross over you: maximum health +‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: A wheel cast from the tracks of stars. Thrown, it shatters on the ground and leaves a brief stretch of good fortune behind. For 20 seconds, those it covers take half damage while their wounds and bleeding ebb away. It does not tell friend from foe — fortune never picks.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖65‖end‖% damage resistance for 20 seconds, and your wounds and bleeding are slowly ebbing away.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_divination: Your ‖color:gui.orange‖Medical skill‖end‖ increases by ‖color:gui.green‖45‖end‖. You deal more ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖, and ‖color:gui.orange‖the higher your Medical skill, the greater the bonus‖end‖: Medical 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 each raise it another step, from ‖color:gui.green‖+10‖end‖% up to ‖color:gui.green‖+30‖end‖%. Every time you make a ‖color:gui.orange‖ranged attack‖end‖, crew within ‖color:gui.green‖1000‖end‖ units gain ‖color:gui.green‖+15‖end‖% damage for 20 seconds, then it goes on a 120-second cooldown.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_divination_buf: The stars have been read in your favour: you deal ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% more damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_divination_cd: Divination is on cooldown — you cannot read the stars for your crew just yet.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_starchart_killxp: Whenever a crewmate kills an enemy, you gain ‖color:gui.green‖[amount]‖end‖ experience.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_placeholde: This talent is still on the drawing board — it currently does nothing.
This talent is still on the drawing board — it currently does nothing.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_sect: Neutral Sect keeps both phases active at once: · ‖color:gui.orange‖Aspected Benefic‖end‖: when you apply treatment to an ally, they gain an additional ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% maximum health until the end of the round. · ‖color:gui.orange‖Helios Conjunction‖end‖: crew within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units gain a permanent aura of ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% maximum health and ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖% movement speed. The two stack with each other.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: The Wheel surrounds you: you take ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% less damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_ascend: Whenever someone is unconscious, the ‖color:gui.orange‖CPR‖end‖ you perform is ‖color:gui.green‖100‖end‖% more effective.\nYou bring people back from unconsciousness twice as fast.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ascend: Someone has fallen: the rescuer's hands work twice as fast.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_gravity: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖stun resistance‖end‖ — harder to knock down or stagger.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_primary_gravit: Gravity holds you steady: ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% stun resistance.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_exaltation: The stars walk beside you: you take ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% less damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_astral: Your ‖color:gui.orange‖skill gain speed‖end‖ is increased by ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖%.\nEach ally you treat adds ‖color:gui.green‖1‖end‖ stack of Astral; each stack adds a further ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖%, up to ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ stacks (‖color:gui.green‖100‖end‖% in total).\nThe talent panel shows your current stacks.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_epicycle: You move at full speed while dragging a character.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_esuna: When you apply a ‖color:gui.orange‖hemostatic‖end‖ to a crewmate, it also clears their ‖color:gui.orange‖bleeding, burns and blood loss‖end‖.\nHemostatics normally only stop bleeding — this turns them into proper first aid.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_draw_star: The deck of the astral. Hold it and press use to draw: The Balance, The Arrow and The Spire fall into it. Sixty seconds after the draw, the deck and any cards left in it fade away, and the umbral deck takes its place.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_draw_umbral: The deck of the umbral. Hold it and press use to draw: The Spear, The Bole and The Ewer fall into it. Sixty seconds after the draw, the deck and any cards left in it fade away, and the astral deck takes its place.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_balance: A scale with life on one end and death on the other. Hold it and press use to raise the whole crew's damage dealt.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_arrow: An arrow that never lands. Hold it and press use to raise the whole crew's walking and swimming speed.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_spire: A tower that reaches upward. Hold it and press use to raise the whole crew's repair speed and hull repair rate.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_spear: A spear thrown never to be retrieved. Hold it and press use to raise the whole crew's attack speed.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_bole: The trunk that holds the world up. Hold it and press use to reduce the damage the whole crew takes.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_ewer: A pitcher of endless water. Hold it and press use to reduce the whole crew's oxygen consumption.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_synastry: When you treat an ally, your fates briefly intertwine: you slowly recover as well.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_exaltation: While a crewmate is within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units, you take ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% less ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖.\nThe stars only shine for those who walk together — the protection fades when you are alone.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_synastry: Your fate is intertwined with another's; your wounds are slowly ebbing away.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_minor: Every draw yields one extra minor arcana.\nAstral Draw grants the ‖color:gui.orange‖Lord of Crowns‖end‖, Umbral Draw the ‖color:gui.orange‖Lady of Crowns‖end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_lord: The burning face of the crown. It is simply a frag grenade — pull the pin, throw it, and wait for the fuse.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_lady: The merciful face of the crown. A fix-foam grenade — pull the pin, throw it, and it seals the hull all around where it lands.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_drew_star: The Astral Draw is in effect.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_drew_umbral: The Umbral Draw is in effect.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_deck_used: Hidden marker: this deck has already been drawn from. Wait for it to flip to the other pole.
